Fix accident cases found by a security review: (1) git push is free only as: git push with zero positionals (pushes the current branch), git push REMOTE with exactly one positional that is a configured remote name (read git remote with a 3 second timeout; if it cannot be read, or the one positional is not a remote, the push is not free), or git push REMOTE BRANCH with exactly two positionals; more than two positionals or any refspec with src not equal to dst is not free; the branch pushed (explicit or the current branch when omitted) must not be main, master or HEAD; use the refspecs field. A push with delete true on any refspec, --mirror or --prune, or force on main or master is blocked and never approvable for main and master. (2) git fetch is free only with zero positionals, or one positional that is a configured remote, with options limited to --all, --prune, -p, --tags, -q, --quiet; any other form (a refspec containing a colon, a dot repository, options with an equals sign) is not free. (3) the early return after a passing content-hash check must not skip the other checks: the whole command line is judged first (file writes, git add working tree check, push check, global options) and a command is allowed only if every part is allowed. (4) git add, commit and push are not free when the command has any of -C, --git-dir, --work-tree, or an environment prefix word starting with GIT_ (globalOpts or an env assignment of that kind). (5) a command with result.dynamic or result.unknown is not free: it needs an approval that names the files or ops, or is blocked, exactly like an unknown write today. (6) protect transcripts: text-level writes to the top-level jsonl files of any project folder under the home .claude folder in projects are blocked like the settings files (the memory subfolders stay allowed). (7) tools/orchestrator-events.mjs isHandBuilt must use the symlink-resolving routing check (isRoutingPathResolved in tools/routing-paths.mjs; make sure it is exported and used) so a symlink named like a manifest does not hide a source edit, and the scratchpad and memory exemptions must resolve symlinks before judging. Implement the contract and fix accident cases found by a security review: (1) find: handle -delete and -exec as independent actions: a find with both reports the delete; every -exec ... ; or -exec ... + action in one find is analyzed on its own; -fprint, -fprintf, -fls after an -exec are still checked; a find with no explicit starting directory that deletes or execs a writer is unknown. (2) It must match, with or without the swarm word and with the swarm.mjs script path forms (node tools/swarm.mjs, node swarm.mjs, node with any path ending in swarm.mjs, the swarm launcher): handbuild followed by approve, deny, on, off, install or uninstall; decide followed by any arguments that include approve (any id, not only handbuild- ids); inbox-commands; orchestrator-hook; recordChatMerge; writing to the guard state folder; also python or node inline scripts that mention swarm together with decide or handbuild. (3) Keep false positives low: ordinary commands (git status, swarm go, swarm run, swarm tickets, swarm handbuild status, swarm handbuild request) must stay false; swarm handbuild request is the way the orchestrator asks and must be allowed.
